visual.where: m13 (p127), tab rail on all pages

visual.issue: Start here step 4 names the Self-care menu and the Hard day plan, but its only Go there button opens the menu.
Setup check promises buttons that jump and come back, but there is no direct return. The target pages' trails lead to Weeks, Contents or Home, so returning takes Home, then Setup check.

Arrow placement is inconsistent. Hub and tool pages have small arrows beside the trail, while week, journal, month and notes pages use large arrow buttons below it. The listing says 'on every page arrows and a trail at the top right', but the cover has neither.
visual.where: w01, jr01, m01, notes vs index/start/menu; listing

visual.issue: The hero crop has no inner margin: the 'Check in' kicker touches the frame, and the Dates 'to' line runs off the right edge.
The journal crop cuts through the My answer box at the bottom edge, and the kicker sits tight to the frame.
The left crop cuts off the bottom of the 5 and 15 minute columns, so the box has no bottom edge.
Both crops show only 2 of each page's 3 columns: Boundaries and Small things that help are out of frame. The shown columns are mostly blank tick rows.
Empty bands: the bottom quarter of photos 6 and 8 and the top third of photos 7 and 10 are bare background. Photo 10 also has a clipped honey arc in the top-right corner that reads as a stray mark.
Photo 9's point '13 months and 5 tools' does not match anything a buyer can count in the photo: Contents shows 10 section cards.
The Energy map's write-in lists use tick boxes, including under 'Drains my energy', where ticking makes little sense.
